why: This edit points the `drowned-wrap` row at `textures/drowned-player-layout.png`, which the gallery generator paints on the player model's jacket, sleeve and pants positions. The drowned's outer layer is a grown copy of the base model and samples the BASE positions, so every one of those pixels lands on no box it builds and draws nothing: the sheet The Stranding first shipped. The refusal names the models whose boxes the paint does fit.
